commitResults.messageTitle: Add single-step undo command and button
commitResults.messageBody:
Accidental data changes require users to reconstruct previous records.
Keep one snapshot of the last saved data change and restore it through
an undo command and a button sharing the normal persistence path.

Consume the snapshot only after saving succeeds so failed undo attempts
can be retried. Preserve linked records and order identities, and leave
history unchanged after read-only, no-op, or failed commands.

Add persistence and JavaFX button tests, update user and developer guides,
and include undo usage in Help. Verify the full build and Checkstyle.

Refs #97

with rollback and retry status. Log snapshot updates at FINE level to
help diagnose undo state without changing application behavior.

available for recall without logging command or draft contents.

commitResults.messageTitle: Wait for rendered layout in Help resize test
commitResults.messageBody:
Preferred-height changes can precede native scene resizing and viewport
layout on Windows. Waiting for that property alone checks transient
geometry and can fail even when the text eventually fits.

Wait for the requested scene width and stable post-layout geometry before
checking content fit. Compare preferred heights consistently across
resizes, check every usage summary, and report dimensions on failures.
Always remove pulse listeners and close the test window.

Verify three consecutive Help suite runs on Windows and the full build
with tests and Checkstyle.
